title: Night Lounge | Luxe Rooftop Retreat + City Views
description:
Welcome to The Night Lounge. This moody, upscale townhome and rooftop is less than a mile to Broadway and offers stunning views of the Nashville skyline.
 
If you’re looking for a comfortable place to relax and hang with friends in between your Nashville adventures, this is it. Come in, pour yourself a drink, and stay a while. For larger groups, message us about renting our other attached units!

Guest access
There is a smartlock to enter.
